resources.string: Flip-card clock with the date and your next alarm
Your launcher can\'t add widgets from here. Long-press the home screen, tap Widgets, find Flip Clock.

Or add it by hand:
1. Long-press an empty spot on your home screen
2. Tap Widgets
3. Find Flip Clock
4. Drag it onto the home screen

Tap the clock to open your alarms. Tap the date to open your calendar.
